targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  project_status,
  project_name,
  project_url,
  project_team,
  project_default_branch,
  last_commit_author,
  last_commit_email,
  last_commit_created,
  info_vulns,
  low_vulns,
  medium_vulns,
  high_vulns,
  critical_vulns,
  new,
  closed,
  false_positive,
  reopened,
  awaiting_review,
  gss as "GSS",
  iac as "IAC",
  sca_license as "SCA-license",
  sca_vuln as "SCA-vulnerabilities"
FROM
  vc_view_general_vulnerabilities_statistic
WHERE 
project_name = ANY(string_to_array('${project_name:csv}', ','))

SELECT 
  SUM(info_vulns) as "info",
  SUM(low_vulns) as "low",
  SUM(medium_vulns) as "medium",
  SUM(high_vulns) as "high",
  SUM(critical_vulns) as "critical"
FROM vc_view_general_vulnerabilities_statistic

SELECT 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'new') as "new",
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'closed') as "closed",
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'awaiting_review') as "awaiting_review", 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'false_positive') as "false_positive", 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'reopened') as "reopened"  
FROM vc_vuln v

SELECT 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.connector_type = 'gss') as "gss",
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.connector_type = 'iac') as "iac",
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.connector_type = 'sca_vuln') as "sca_vuln", 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.connector_type = 'sca_license') as "sca_license"
FROM vc_vuln v

SELECT
  control_type,
  severity,
  COUNT(*)
FROM vc_view_project_vulnerabilities_statistic
GROUP BY control_type, severity
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Number of vulnerabilities by scanner and severity level

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.severity = 'info') as "info",
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.severity = 'low') as "low",
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.severity = 'medium') as "medium", 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.severity = 'high') as "high", 
  COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.severity = 'critical') as "critical"  
FROM vc_vuln v
JOIN vc_project p on p.id = v.project_id
WHERE p.team = ANY(string_to_array('${team:csv}', ',')::userteam[])
AND v.status = 'new'

SELECT
  platform,
  COUNT(*)
FROM vc_view_iac_vulnerabilities_statistic
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT
  cwe_id,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM vc_view_iac_vulnerabilities_statistic
GROUP BY cwe_id
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT
  package_name,
  COUNT(*)
FROM vc_view_sca_vuln_vulnerabilities_statistic
GROUP BY package_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Top 50 packages with vulnerabilities by frequency of use

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  project_name,
  severity,
  status,
  filepath,
  line,
  code_snippet,
  rule_name,
  rule_text_id,
  commit_id,
  branch
FROM
  vc_view_gss_vulnerabilities_statistic
WHERE project_name = ANY(string_to_array('${project_name:csv}', ','))
  AND severity = ANY(string_to_array('${severity:csv}', ',')::vulnseverity[])
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'high'     THEN 2
    WHEN 'medium'   THEN 3
    WHEN 'low'      THEN 4
    WHEN 'info'     THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END ASC

SELECT
  project_name,
  severity,
  status,
  filepath,
  line,
  platform,
  category,
  description,
  actual_value,
  recommended_value,
  recommendation_url,
  cwe_url,
  rule_name,
  rule_text_id,
  rule_search_key
FROM
  vc_view_iac_vulnerabilities_statistic
WHERE project_name = ANY(string_to_array('${project_name:csv}', ','))
  AND severity = ANY(string_to_array('${severity:csv}', ',')::vulnseverity[])
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'high'     THEN 2
    WHEN 'medium'   THEN 3
    WHEN 'low'      THEN 4
    WHEN 'info'     THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END ASC

SELECT
  project_name,
  severity,
  status,
  filepath,
  package_name,
  license,
  license_description
FROM
  vc_view_sca_license_vulnerabilities_statistic
WHERE project_name = ANY(string_to_array('${project_name:csv}', ','))
  AND severity = ANY(string_to_array('${severity:csv}', ',')::vulnseverity[])
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'high'     THEN 2
    WHEN 'medium'   THEN 3
    WHEN 'info'     THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END ASC

SELECT
  project_name,
  severity,
  status,
  package_manager,
  package_name,
  package_fixed_version,
  package_vuln_status,
  vuln_title,
  vuln_description,
  cvss_score as "vendor_cvss",
  package_installed_version,
  recommendation_url
FROM
  vc_view_sca_vuln_vulnerabilities_statistic
WHERE project_name = ANY(string_to_array('${project_name:csv}', ','))
  AND severity = ANY(string_to_array('${severity:csv}', ',')::vulnseverity[])
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'high'     THEN 2
    WHEN 'medium'   THEN 3
    WHEN 'info'     THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END ASC
